item.description: • Long conversations no longer cost more and more to remember. When your Kit refreshed its summary of an ongoing chat, it re-read the entire conversation from the beginning every time, so the longer a thread ran the more it cost to keep up with. It now reads only what you have said since the last summary, which it already had the notes to do. On a long thread that is a fortieth of the work, and on a local model it is the difference between a summary that finishes and one that times out.
